channel.title: Tessera — Changelog
channel.description: What shipped, in order — receipts the kernel agrees with.

item.title: Bootstrap receipt · 2026-08-05 — tinyllama-1.1b TESSERA_T640
item.description: Aggregate t_l² 0.0016 — 202/202 tensors validated — kernel T640 sha256:7f3a…c9e1

item.title: L1–L6 telemetry spine lands (v3.1 spec)
item.description: The six-layer runtime-aware measurement loop is implemented in C++: FP16 reference capture, activation differentials + spectral norm/erank, KL attribution, prompt bank, Hessian sensitivity scorer (Cholesky + dispatch), tail-weighted loss.

item.title: Granite T640 family support
item.description: granite-4.1-30b, guardian-4.1-8b, granite-4.0-h-small are first-class T640 targets; granite4vision, granite-docling, granite-speech-plus, and the modern-bert embeddings convert and load through the singular GGUF pipeline.

item.title: D-PACE loss + DFlash block dataset
item.description: Adaptive per-position D-PACE weights replace the fixed exponential decay; the DFlash block dataset emits from spec_calib.v2. The drafter training driver (feature capture + weighted CE) is the next link.

item.title: Tessera Observatory v1 — site goes live
item.description: Hand-authored HTML, Observatory design, GitHub Pages deploy on push to main. DRY assembler site/scripts/build.py now generates all 8 pages.
